quantitative.name: 定量与实验 / Quantitative and experimental
quantitative.applies_to: Measured observations, simulations, interventions, engineering evaluations; use only where justified by the question.
quantitative.guidance: Specify what variation the uncertainty describes. Freeze confirmatory comparisons before seeing their outcomes; label exploratory analysis. Record failed and negative runs, seeds, software, configuration and raw outputs. Match baselines and budgets. Distinguish causal effects from association; synthetic demonstrations support bounded claims only.

qualitative.name: 质性研究 / Qualitative inquiry
qualitative.applies_to: Interviews, observation, case studies, thematic and grounded analyses, where their epistemological assumptions fit.
qualitative.guidance: Do not fabricate participants, quotations, fieldwork or consent. Separate participant accounts from researcher interpretation. Preserve context and positionality, inspect disconfirming cases, and explain how interpretations were developed. Choose saturation, triangulation or agreement checks only when appropriate to the declared approach; do not demand quantitative significance.

interpretive.name: 解释与人文研究 / Interpretive and humanities research
interpretive.applies_to: Historical, philosophical, textual, archival and hermeneutic inquiry; research standards follow the material and interpretive tradition.
optional_tools: available digital archive or corpus tools
interpretive.guidance: Trace readings to passages and editions. Explain translation choices, selection and omissions. Distinguish what the material says from an interpretation, consider rival readings and avoid anachronism. A small corpus does not establish a historical population trend. Computational counts can inform a reading but do not settle its meaning. Experimental falsifiability and statistical power are not universal requirements.

formal.name: 形式化与理论 / Formal and theoretical
formal.applies_to: Mathematical, logical, conceptual and formal theoretical claims with explicit assumptions.
formal.guidance: Expose every substantive inference and dependency, check limiting cases, and search for counterexamples. Distinguish theorem, conjecture and illustrative calculation. Finite numerical tests do not prove a universal statement. Formalization is optional when the chosen theoretical tradition does not require machine checking.

synthesis.name: 文献综合 / Evidence synthesis
synthesis.applies_to: Narrative, scoping and systematic reviews, conceptual syntheses and meta-analysis when justified.
synthesis.guidance: Distinguish records from studies and metadata verification from full-text verification. Record searches, dates and exclusions. Inspect primary sources before attributing findings; inaccessible material remains unverified. Do not call a bounded narrative scan systematic or pool incompatible studies without justification.

mixed.name: 混合方法 / Mixed methods
mixed.applies_to: Studies combining multiple methodological traditions with an explicit integration rationale.
mixed.guidance: Load the component method modules as well. Explain where integration changes the inference. Preserve tensions rather than forcing agreement, and do not let one component's stronger evidence erase another component's limitations.

iclr-2026.name: ICLR 2026 评议 / ICLR 2026 review
iclr-2026.applies_to: Optional venue-specific review of work relevant to ICLR; not a universal academic quality model.
inputs: review authorization and applicable confidentiality rules
iclr-2026.guidance: Follow the official 2026 guide's four questions. Lack of state-of-the-art performance alone is not a reason to reject. Separate decisive concerns from improvement suggestions and unknowns. Report evidence locations and uncertainty. The official numeric review-form scale has not been verified in this package: give narrative judgments only, without invented numeric scores, acceptance probabilities or calibrated-review claims. Check current official policies before an actual submission or confidential review.
